notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. The only source that names a tower here is one row of the tnlandforms NC list (NCT143). Mapcarta and TopoZone confirm only a 3,005-ft summit at this spot; neither mentions a tower. The list is titled as lookout towers, but nothing else found confirms one stood here, so consider holding the story or marking it unverified. Coordinates differ by roughly 100 m between the list (35.65138,-82.56777) and TopoZone (35.6514997,-82.5684616). The shared web-search budget ran out after one search for this lookout, so no register, agency or newspaper source was checked. Story sits at about 120 words, the floor for thin evidence, because the evidence is one line.
